data.notes: Search budget (20) exhausted. Manufacturer data used where found (Volvo newsrooms for S60 III, V60 II, V60 CC II dimensions); trunk volumes mostly from secondary sources (ADAC, ams, AUTO BILD, autozeitung, AutoScout24/mobile.de, UK reviews). Variant powerPs mostly null because not verified.

corrections.evidence: angurten.de: S60 III 'Baujahr: 2019 - 2024', production end December 2024; 'Die Limousine S60 hat Volvo mittlerweile komplett von der Webseite entfernt' - unlike the V60, German sales too low. US production in Ridgeville ended June 2024 (motor1 'The Volvo S60 Is Dead'). Not an official Volvo DE statement, but no evidence it is still sold in Germany.

ADAC V60 B4 Core DKG (12/21-07/24): Kofferraumvolumen normal 519 l, umgeklappt 1431 l; carwow.de also 519-1431 l. Applies to later model years (MY2022+); MY2019 figure was 529/1441 (TCS test, Volvo newsroom). Consider a model-year split rather than replacing, or a yearFrom-limited variant.
ADAC B4 Core DKG (12/21-07/24): 1431 l folded; Volvo UK/DE later MY data also 1431 l max.

Volvo Deutschland (manufacturer, current MY) V60 T6 AWD Plug-in Hybrid: Gepäckraum hinter 2. Sitzreihe 519 l, hinter 1. Sitzreihe max. 1431 l; AutoScout24.at T8 AWD Recharge: 519-1431 l. MY2019 T8: TCS test 529-1441 l (VDA, matches original); ADAC (10/18-04/19) 475 l / 1393 l is an ADAC measurement, not manufacturer. So 529 valid for early MY, 519 for later MY - no evidence of PHEV-specific boot loss vs. non-PHEV.
Volvo DE current spec page: max. 1431 l behind first row (T6 AWD Plug-in Hybrid).

missing.detail: S60 Cross Country (sedan, 2015-2018) was sold in Germany from June 2015 (Volvo DE press release 'Verkaufsstart', only D4 Summum from 43,840 EUR). angurten.de (https://www.angurten.de/is/abmessungen/1714-volvo-s60-cross-country): length 4638 mm, height 1539 mm, ground clearance 201 mm, trunk 380 l; pkw.de 4635 x 1540 mm; Autoflotte test 2016: 380 l. Not in data.

verification.notes: Search budget (20) used. Confirmed: C70 II pre-facelift 4582 x 1820 x 1400, wb 2640, 404 l roof up / ~200 l roof down (AutoScout24, AutoBild 2006 test, autoplenum 4580); facelift length 4615 mm confirmed by vehiclesizes.com ('C70 Coupe Cabrio II facelift 2009') and fastcarcheck (2009-2013) - split justified; C70 production ended 2013 (Uddevalla, Wikipedia/Motor Authority). V60 Cross Country I: encycarpedia 4638 x 1545, wb 2774, 430-1241 l (length 1 mm off, not corrected; width shown 1899 there, unclear - AutoScout24.at lists 380-1407 l, likely different method). V60 CC II: ams 4784 x 1850 x 1499 (B5 AWD Pro), autozine/encycarpedia 529/1441 l (ams own measurement 495-1407 l); later MY likely 519/1431 like V60 II but not verified. S60 II: 380 l, 4628, wb 2776 confirmed (carsales, AutoScout24); folded not found. S60 III: 442 l and PHEV 390 l confirmed (ADAC S60 T8 06/19-03/20: 391 l), height 1431 vs 1437 conflict persists. V60 I: 4628/1484/1865, 430/1241 confirmed (autozine.nl); D6 PHEV trunk unclear: TCS test 305 l, AutoBild 330 l, AutoScout24 304-1120 l - left unconfirmed, no correction. S60 III yearTo correction relies on a single non-manufacturer source.
